info.title: Transport Tractor Management System (TTMS)
info.description: Enterprise-grade tractor and trip management API built on Clean Architecture.

post.description: OAuth2 compatible token login, get an access token for future requests.

get.summary: Get paginated list of users with search support
get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users. If a query 'q' is provided, performs a text-based search.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search query string matching email, username, or name.
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Search query string matching email, username, or name.

post.description: Enables administrators to register new users in the system.

get.description: Retrieves user profile details and role configurations by ID.

put.description: Updates profile values of a user.

patch.description: Performs partial updates on user details.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user profile and revokes all active session refresh tokens.

post.description: Assigns an authorization role group to a user account.

delete.description: Revokes an authorization role group from a user account.

get.description: Lists all defined active roles.

post.description: Registers a new authorization role definition in the system.
Binds an access permission privilege to a role configuration.

delete.description: Unbinds an access permission privilege from a role configuration.

get.description: Lists all defined permissions (system access rights).

get.summary: Get paginated list of drivers with search and filter support

Retrieves a paginated list of drivers with optional search, sorting, and status filtering.

get.description: Retrieves driver details and licensing info by ID.

put.description: Updates configuration values of an active driver.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a driver profile, checking active trips constraints.

patch.description: Toggles logical is_active status of a driver.

post.description:
Registers a new tractor profile after validating unique constraints.
Requires 'tractors:create' permission scope.

get.description: Retrieves detailed properties for a single active tractor profile.

put.description:
Updates the configuration of an existing active tractor profile.
Enforces unique checks. Requires 'tractors:update' scope.

delete.description:
Soft-deletes a tractor profile. Blocks deletion if tractor is linked to active trips.
Requires 'tractors:delete' scope.

patch.description:
Enables or disables a tractor profile logically.
Requires 'tractors:update' scope.

get.summary: Get paginated list of trips with search and filter support
get.description: Retrieves a paginated page of trips. Include deleted is restricted to admins.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Search by trip number, location, remarks, driver, tractor, or party.
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Search by trip number, location, remarks, driver, tractor, or party.

post.description: Registers a new trip profile after validation checks and busy checks.

get.description: Returns active trips (DISPATCHED and IN_PROGRESS).
Retrieves detailed properties for a single active trip.

put.description: Updates the configuration of an existing active trip profile.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a trip transaction if it is in PENDING status.

patch.description: Shifts the state of a trip inside the state workflow machine.

get.summary: Get trip status change timeline history
get.description: Returns timeline logs of status transitions for a trip.

post.description: Creates a new operational expense entry under an active, non-completed trip.

get.summary: Get paginated list of trip expenses with filtering
get.description: Retrieves filtered list of operational expenses with sorting and pagination.

get.summary: Get trip expense details by ID
get.description: Retrieves complete detail for a single trip expense entry.

put.summary: Update trip expense details by ID
put.description: Updates properties of an existing trip expense entry.

delete.summary: Soft delete a trip expense entry
delete.description: Soft deletes a trip expense transaction from operational log.

get.summary: Get all expenses for a specific trip
get.description: Retrieves all active expenses linked to the specified Trip.

get.summary: Get aggregated expense summary for a trip
get.description: Returns total and grouped expense category aggregates for a single trip.

get.summary: Get detailed profit and margins details for a trip
get.description: Returns profit margins percentages, freight sum, total expenses and net profit for a trip.

get.summary: Get comprehensive aggregated context for single-screen rendering
get.description: Returns the comprehensive aggregated dataset (financials, expenses list, history timeline) for the trip screen.
